title: Founder situation and decision-specific matching

files.change: Reuse customer/model/objective/constraints; add nullable product phase, company-vs-product scope, anchor type, team/capital bands without invented defaults.
Validate/serialize structured founder context; keep old clients supported.
Decision taxonomy and sector-specific follow-up questions; avoid generic question as the action.
Replace event-level age-only selection and modulo distribution with episode relevance and explicit rationale.

steps: Ask progressively, not a long form; unknowns explicit. Product age uses named sourced anchor or a transparent interval, never parent founding by default.
Require decision-relevant claim types; no IPO-as-demand proof or product launch-as-retention proof.
Return case_study, supported_pattern, partial and insufficient semantics with known differences. A case can be useful without claiming a pattern.
Don't equate two company IDs with a repeated pattern; verify shared action/context and independent source families.
Historical relevance not penalized just for age; freshness tracked for live regulatory conditions separately.
tests: Changing objective changes ranked episodes or explains gap.
Same sector but different customer/business model loses rank or fails applicable gates.
Mature-company early product can match new product context but not masquerade as a new company.
Zero/one/multiple cases render honestly; no empty directions caused by arbitrary list slicing.
completion_evidence: golden matching benchmark including negative cases
